author: The Current
description:
The Suicide Commandos share stories of Minneapolis music history
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

In an interview with The Current's Jill Riley, Chris Osgood and Dave Ahl of pioneering Minneapolis punk band The Suicide Commandos talk about how they helped propel the careers of Bob Mould, Craig Finn, and The Suburbs. 

The Suicide Commandos will play a Farewell Blow Out Show at First Avenue in Minneapolis on Saturday, March 28. More info can be found at thecurrent.org/giglist
